ev: Numerous streets flooded in Canton with some vehicles stalled or partially submerged in flood waters, along with water entering buildings and homes.
Multiple streets were flooded across the County.
A culvert along Fordyke Road was washed out.

Widespread flooding along with some significant flooding occurred across the Canton area due to heavy rainfall. Radar estimated rainfall of 5 to 8 inches fell in and to the north of Canton. Numerous streets were flooded with multiple cars stalled or partially submerged in flood waters. Water also entered several buildings and homes.
lsr: NUMEROUS STREETS FLOODED IN CANTON, SOME VEHICLES STALLED IN FLOOD WATERS. ADDITIONAL SOCIAL MEDIA PICTURES AND VIDEO SHOW WATER AT OR ENTERING HOMES.
